title: Should You Sell on Corkscrew Road Before 14,500 More Homes Arrive? Southwest Florida 2026
excerpt: Roughly 14,500 homes are already approved east of Estero's finished communities and mostly unbuilt, while the next two Corkscrew Road widenings sit on the adopted MPO 2050 plan's needs list. If you plan to sell within three or four years, that window narrows rather than widens.
